jobs.description: At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical EntitiesYou are an experienced synthetic and process chemist with the ambition to shape the chemical foundation of our R&D pipeline for new chemical entities (NCEs) by designing, developing, and enabling synthetic routes that evolve into robust API manufacturing processes in partnership with our external CDMO network.In this Drug Substance (DS) Lead position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. Serving as the central interface between internal stakeholders and external partners, you lead chemical process development and API supply activities, enabling phase-appropriate, scalable, and sustainable manufacturing processes that ensure timely API delivery, robust product quality, and cost efficiency.YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES- Provide scientific leadership for the design, assessment, and optimization of synthetic routes for new APIs in preclinical and clinical phases, with a focus on speed, quality, cost, sustainability, and process understanding- Represent Drug Substance (DS) in global CMC development project teams and contribute to key scientific, strategic, and portfolio decisions, while ensuring a coherent two-way flow of strategy, decisions, risks, and progress between the internal global CMC team and external CDMO activities- Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight- Steer process transfers between external partners and into internal development or external manufacturing, ensuring knowledge continuity and phase-appropriate documentation- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundariesWHO YOU ARE- Ph.D. in Chemistry or a related science, with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including an understanding of GLP/GMP and regulatory expectations- Strong background in synthetic chemistry, with an excellent understanding of reagents, methodologies, and reaction mechanisms, plus a solid grasp of analytical techniques- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners- A strategic thinker with the ability to think innovatively, develop and analyze multiple solutions to complex chemistry problems, and challenge the status quo- Strong communication and project management skills across scientific disciplines, cultures, and organizational boundaries, combined with assertiveness, service orientation, and enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork- Fluency in English (negotiation level), both written and spoken; German is an asset and willingness to learn German is requiredWHAT WE OFFEROur benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.Be You. models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).• English fluency (our client base is international).• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.WHAT WE OFFER:• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.LEARN MORE:www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]Join our mission to help every child reach their full potential through developmentally respectful, relationship-based care. Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plusOUR OFFER TO YOU·       Modern and dynamic work environment·       Flexible and mobile working·       Attractive fitness offer·       Numerous employee discounts·       Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as Lead Data Steward (w/m/d) and become the central coordination point for data governance and data management across the Substations organization. You will connect business stakeholders, country Data Stewards, and Siemens Energy data domains to turn business priorities into governed actions and measurable improvements. Working across functions, countries, and enterprise data domains, you will help align governance activities, improve data quality, and strengthen data management practices. You will enable a global network of Data Stewards while supporting the adoption of enterprise standards, platforms, and best practices. Through governance coordination and scalable rollout activities, you will help drive transparency, consistency, and continuous improvement across the organization.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead coordination of data governance activities across business functions, countries, and enterprise data domains, ensuring alignment with enterprise governance standards* Drive transparency on data ownership, data quality, risks, and governance priorities, while maintaining governance backlogs, decision logs, and escalation paths* Support data cataloging, metadata management, lineage documentation, and data quality initiatives within the SE Data Catalog* Collaborate with country Data Stewards to document critical data assets, gather business requirements, and build a connected global stewardship network* Facilitate pilot implementations, onboarding activities, governance reviews, and management reporting while promoting enterprise standards, platforms, and best practicesWhat You Bring* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Management, Business Administration, or equivalent* Many years of professional experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Quality, Business Process Management, or a related discipline* Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives across organizations and countries and translate business requirements into measurable governance improvements* Understanding of data governance frameworks, metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, and master data concepts* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, combined with a structured, pragmatic, and execution-oriented approach in international environments* Fluent in English; additional languages such as German are a plus* Willingness to collaborate globally and travel occasionallyAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO
